question:
The line chart given below shows production of sugar by two companies A and B in 5 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b165f223542252e7aa539a8d6d7fae77f8d91d7f3af8ac04782655744793e689.png] 

Which of the following statement is correct?

I. The production of sugar by A in years J and K together is 7.69 percent more the production of sugar by B in year L and M together.

II. The ratio of combined production of sugar by B in years M and N to the combined production of sugar by A in years K and L is 21 ∶ 16.
solution:
**Calculation:**

I. The production of sugar by A in years J and K together is 7.69 percent **more** the production of sugar by B in year L and M together.

Production of sugar by A in years J and K together = 70 + 50 = 120

Production of sugar by B in year L and M together = 70 + 60 = 130

According to the question:

130 - 120 = 10

10/130 = 7.69%

The production of sugar by A in years J and K together is 7.69% **less** than the production of sugar by B in years L and M together.

Statement I is wrong.

II. The ratio of combined production of sugar by B in years M and N to the combined production of sugar by A in years K and L is 21 ∶ 16.

Production of sugar by B in years M and N = 60 + 45 = 105

Production of sugar by A in years K and L = 50 + 30 = 80

Ratio = 105 : 80 = 21 : 16

Statement II is correct.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
